_readme: Rulings given directly by an XWA team (not from a document or the forum). Each ruling: id, team (who gave it, e.g. 'XWA Epic Team'), date, topic, q (question), a (list of answer paragraphs), cards (card ids the ruling applies to), and epic: true for Epic-only rulings (shown only in Epic mode). Add new ones at the end; never change an id once published.

rulings.q: In an Epic game, when an effect flips a ship's dial faceup, who can view that dial?
a: Only the player with the effect that says to flip the dial can view the dial.
